scope: Standard-route TON caller: one change inserts a new network after the first network and creates its instance storage, as a multi-instance member (createMulti) or a global instance DB (createGlobal), LAD and FBD (4 cells). Each passed the four engineering gates under the network-plus-storage-creation-v1 composite contract: the inserted network follows the renumbering decision, a created multi-instance member is new and shaped exactly like its native template, and the rest of the caller matches its before export exactly.
limitations: Engineering-only; runtime behavior of the composite change is not claimed.
Qualified for the standard-route TON family; other families and the software-unit/namespace routes still rely on separate insertion and storage-creation evidence.
